missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Участник' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'получил'. 'Каждый' agrees in the masculine, and 'значок' is the accusative object. A simple agentive card.

Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Участника' is the accusative, which for an animate masculine noun matches the genitive, as the object of 'наградило'. 'Лучшего' agrees in the masculine animate accusative.

missions.phrase: На встрече не было одного участника.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Участника' takes the genitive after 'не было' to mark non-presence. 'Одного' agrees in the masculine genitive. A standard negation frame.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Участнику' takes the dative as the person helped by 'помог', a verb that governs the dative. 'Новому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'доволен'. 'Участником' takes the instrumental required by the short adjective 'доволен'. 'Новым' agrees in the masculine instrumental. A useful evaluation frame.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об участнике' uses the prepositional 'участнике' after 'о' to express talking about the person. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.

missions.phrase: В конкурсе участвуют три новых участника.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive singular after 'три'. After the numeral 'три' the noun takes the genitive singular 'участника'. 'Новых' agrees in the genitive plural with the counted set. A key number-noun rule.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural of an animate noun. 'Участников' is the genitive-form accusative plural, as animate nouns take the genitive ending in the plural. 'Всех' agrees, the object of 'поблагодарило'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Участники' is the nominative plural subject of 'пришли'. 'Все' agrees in the plural, and 'вовремя' adds the manner. A clean plural model.
Strategic focus: Dative plural recipients. 'Участникам' is the dative plural marking the people who received the forms. 'Анкеты' is the accusative plural object. A useful give-to-many pattern.
